name: Sparkborne Magic
description:
Fast Action: Equip this to your Klee.
Attach Explosive Spark to Klee.
When the attached character uses a Charged Attack: Deals 2 Pyro DMG. (Twice per Round)
(You must have Klee in your deck to add this card to your deck.)
